description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: career-ops: open-source AI job search agent

Built and used by [santifer](https://santifer.io) for his own job search: 740 listings evaluated, 68 applied, 12 interviews, 1 offer, a Head of Applied AI role. The archetypes, scoring, and negotiation scripts reflect that search; his portfolio is also open source: [cv-santiago](https://github.com/santifer/cv-santiago).

It works out of the box, but it's designed to be made yours.** You (AI Agent) can edit the user's files: they say "change the archetypes to data engineering roles" and you do it. That's the whole point.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
